android.desc: Elevate your workflow with the most powerful and secure Bluetooth remote control for your devices. Turn your Android phone into a serverless keyboard, mouse, and presentation tool—no additional software needed. Seamlessly control your computer, tablet, or media center with unparalleled versatility. Our direct Bluetooth connection ensures instant response and requires no server software, keeping your connection private and secure. Your Professional Toolkit Includes: • Precision Control: A highly responsive keyboard, mouse, and multi-touch trackpad with intuitive scrolling. • Keep-Alive / Jiggler Mode: Prevent your computer from sleeping or locking. Keep your status active on communication platforms during long tasks or when working remotely.* • Full PC Keyboard: Type efficiently with a standard layout and switch instantly between over 100 international language layouts.* • Presenter Mode: Command your presentations with confidence. Navigate slides, control your pointer, and engage your audience from anywhere in the room.* • Multimedia Control: Effortlessly manage playback, volume, and navigation for media players and streaming services.* • Integrated Scanner: Scan QR codes and barcodes directly to your connected device, streamlining data entry and inventory tasks.* • Voice & Clipboard Sync: Use voice-to-text for quick input or send copied text from your phone to your computer in a single tap.* • Custom Layouts: Engineer the perfect remote interface. Build custom controls tailored to your specific software, applications, or games. * Pro Feature Universal Compatibility: The receiving device requires only a standard Bluetooth connection. Tested and verified on the following operating systems: • Windows 8.1 and higher • Apple iOS and iPad OS • Android and Android TV • Chromebook Chrome OS • Steam Deck Support & Feedback: Have a feature request or require assistance? Join our developer and community-led Discord channel for professional support. https://appground.io/discord
